title: Debug: The Invisible Image
prompt:
This image never loads and means nothing to screen readers: the file is named `team-photo.jpg` in the same folder, and the picture shows the five founders at a whiteboard. Repair the element.

Rules:
- `src` points at `team-photo.jpg` (relative).
- `alt` describes the actual picture.
- The element is otherwise unchanged.

tests.name: src points at the real file
tests.hint: Fix the file name and extension: src="team-photo.jpg".

tests.name: alt describes the picture
tests.hint: 'image' describes nothing. Write what someone would see: The five founders at a whiteboard.

tests.name: still a single img element
tests.hint: Edit the attributes in place rather than adding a second image.
